message:
2 helper(s) taken from the suite's own modules by a name no definition in the corpus carries:
      sheen.spec.ts:2 — `styleOf`, imported from `./support/css`
      toast.spec.ts:2 — `styleOf`, imported from `./support/css`
    Every
why: `support/css.ts` gone and `support/dom.ts` left standing — measured on 2026-10-27, when the gate said nothing about it. `boxOf` is still derived, so the reader count is one and `readers` is satisfied, while `styleOf`, which takes every colour and offset the two real bugs were about, is no reader at all: over `hovered-card-race`, `toast-tone-race` or `paused-sheen-baseline` with this file dropped the gate passed, the race and the baseline unreported. Every spec still calls `styleOf`; the corpus no longer holds what it is.
